standard_prerequisites.name: Definition definition-separated (canonical tag 007A): a presheaf is separated if restrictions agreeing on a covering come from a common section, i.e. the restriction maps to the sheafification are injective
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: invoked at proof lines 3688-3690 for the presheaf V \mapsto colim F_i(V) under injective transitions
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes F' separated so the map to its sheafification is injective.

standard_prerequisites.name: Lemma lemma-separated-presheaf-into-sheaf (canonical tag 0082): the canonical map from a separated presheaf into its sheafification is injective

core_obligations: Part (1): with injective transition maps the presheaf F' : V \mapsto colim F_i(V) is separated, (F')^# = colim F_i, and F' \to (F')^# is injective by the separated-into-sheaf lemma (proof lines 3688-3695). Part (2): for quasi-compact U, a finite covering U = \bigcup U_j together with indices i_j \geq i, i_j \geq i' where the images agree on U_j; an index i'' above all i_j makes varphi_{ii''}(s) and varphi_{i'i''}(s') agree on all U_j, hence be equal as sections of the sheaf F_{i''} (proof lines 3697-3712). Part (3): for quasi-compact U with injective transitions, finitely many local sections over U_j; pick i above all i_j; by (1) they agree on overlaps U_j \cap U_{j'} and glue to a section of F_i(U) mapping to s (proof lines 3714-3728). Part (4): U is quasi-compact so \Psi is injective by (2); the finite covering with quasi-compact pairwise intersections lets (2) be applied on each U_j \cap U_{j'} to find i_{jj'} where the local sections agree, and an index above all i_{jj'} lets them glue to a section mapping to s (proof lines 3730-3742).
proof_roadmap: Prove part (1) by separatedness of the colimit presheaf and the separated-into-sheaf lemma (proof lines 3688-3695).
Prove part (2) via a finite covering and directedness (proof lines 3697-3712).
Prove part (3) by glueing finitely many local sections after agreement on overlaps (proof lines 3714-3728).
Prove part (4) by combining (2) on the quasi-compact overlaps with glueing (proof lines 3730-3742).
